question: What are the names of regions in which there are no buildings?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings" AS SELECT "building_id" AS "building_id", "region_id" AS "region_id", "name" AS "name", "address" AS "address", "attribute" AS "attribute", "value" AS "value" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "regions" AS SELECT "region_id" AS "region_id", "capital" AS "capital", "area" AS "area", "population" AS "population", "name_part1" AS "name_part1", "name_part2" AS "name_part2" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH region_names AS (
    SELECT
        r.region_id,
        CASE
            WHEN r.name_part2 IS NULL OR TRIM(r.name_part2) = ''nan'' OR TRIM(r.name_part2) = ''NULL'' OR TRIM(r.name_part2) = ''NaN'' OR TRIM(r.name_part2) = ''None'' OR TRIM(r.name_part2) = ''0'' OR TRIM(r.name_part2) = ''""'' OR TRIM(r.name_part2) = '' '' THEN TRIM(r.name_part1)
            ELSE TRIM(r.name_part1 || ' ' || r.name_part2)
        END AS region_name
    FROM regions r
), building_regions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT region_id FROM buildings
)
SELECT rn.region_name AS region_without_buildings
FROM region_names rn
LEFT JOIN building_regions br ON rn.region_id = br.region_id
WHERE br.region_id IS NULL
ORDER BY rn.region_name
LIMIT 100
